response.author: _Reinhard Zumkeller_, Nov 13 2003
comment: a(n) = if n<3 then 0 else (if n<7 then A071538(n-2)*2 else A071538(n-2)*2-1).
example: a(30) = 7 = #{3,5,7,11,13,17,19}, as (3,5), (5,7), (11,13) and (17,19) are all twin prime pairs with members not greater than 30,
a(31) = 9 = #{3,5,7,11,13,17,19,29,31} with two more members for the next twin prime pair (29,31).
response.name: Number of primes <= n that are members of twin prime pairs.
